summary_1line: Vyasa fathers Pandu and Vidura through niyoga, and the narrative introduces sage Mandavya whose unjust impalement leads to the curse causing Dharma’s birth as Vidura.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ambalika turns pale with fear as the grim sage Vyasa enters her chamber, foretelling the birth of the pale child Pandu.
A humble maid respectfully greets Vyasa in the lamplit chamber, while the sage blesses her that her son will be wise and free.
The ascetic Mandavya sits impaled on a stake beneath a tree, still alive in meditation as other sages arrive in the night as birds.
